verdict.rationale: LiteLLM is a self-hosted gateway (litellm-docs-5), so the operator decides where the proxy and its data run. Logs can go to customer-chosen stores such as GCS, S3, or Azure Blob buckets (litellm-docs-32), message/response logging can be turned off (litellm-docs-12), and the enterprise tier supports multi-region deployment (litellm-docs-38). Residency control is therefore implied by self-hosting rather than offered as an explicit, documented region-selection or data-residency feature. missing for 10: explicit data-residency/region-pinning documentation, controls to route requests to region-specific provider endpoints, residency guarantees for cache/spend data, independent or hands-on corroboration.
